name: tools.secondlayer/secondlayer
title: secondlayer
description: Stacks chain data: contracts, events, transfers, subgraph scaffolds. Hosted with browser sign-in.

tools.name: subgraphs_scaffold
tools.description: Generate a subgraph from observed print events when available; ABI token transfers or public functions only when the contract has never printed. Review the TypeScript, run subgraphs_test until ok: true with written >= 1, read skipped, then subgraphs_deploy. dryRun is DDL only.

subgraphName.description: Override the subgraph name (defaults to contract name)

tools.name: index_ft_transfers
tools.description: List decoded SIP-010 fungible-token transfers from Index. Keyless on OSS loopback; otherwise needs INSTANCE_TOKEN (OSS) or SECONDLAYER_API_KEY (hosted).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's next_cursor

order.description: asc (default) reads oldest first; desc reads newest first. A cursor only resumes under the order that issued it.

assetIdentifier.description: Filter by asset identifier (contract::asset), e.g. SP…sbtc-token::sbtc-token

tools.name: index_nft_transfers
tools.description: List decoded SIP-009 non-fungible-token transfers from Index. Keyless on OSS loopback; otherwise needs INSTANCE_TOKEN (OSS) or SECONDLAYER_API_KEY (hosted).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's next_cursor

order.description: asc (default) reads oldest first; desc reads newest first. A cursor only resumes under the order that issued it.

tools.name: index_events
tools.description: List chain events from the Index by event type. Use this for event types without a dedicated tool (stx_*, ft_mint/burn, nft_mint/burn, print), and for trait-scoped queries: set `trait` (e.g. sip-010) to match all contracts conforming to a standard — pair with contracts_find to discover traits. For ft/nft transfers without a trait prefer index_ft_transfers / index_nft_transfers. Contract state types (nested_contract_call, var_set, map_set, map_insert, map_delete) show what a transaction did inside contracts: every inner contract-call? and every data-var and map write, from genesis on hosted mainnet.

eventType.description: Required. Event type to list: a decoded type or a contract state type.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's next_cursor

order.description: asc (default) reads oldest first; desc reads newest first. A cursor only resumes under the order that issued it.

assetIdentifier.description: Filter by asset identifier where applicable

trait.description: Match contracts conforming to a trait/standard (e.g. sip-010). Mutually exclusive with contractId; contract-keyed event types only.

caller.description: nested_contract_call only: the calling contract or principal

map.description: map_set / map_insert / map_delete only: the map name

txContext.description: Join the submitting transaction into each event (tx_sender, tx_type, tx_status, tx_contract_id, tx_function_name). For print events it's the only source of the submitting sender.

tools.name: index_state_writes
tools.description: List the exact contract-state writes each block committed, in node order: {block_height, ordinal, tx_index, key, value_hex}. Shows which storage key a transaction changed when its events don't. Read one block with blockHeight, or a contract's writes over a height range.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's next_cursor

txContext.description: Join the writing transaction onto each row

tools.name: index_contract_calls
tools.description: List decoded contract calls from the Index (function name, args, result). Set `trait` (e.g. sip-010) to match calls to all contracts conforming to a standard. Note: contract-call cursors are a SEPARATE keyspace from event cursors — they are not interchangeable.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's next_cursor

trait.description: Match contracts conforming to a trait/standard (e.g. sip-010). Mutually exclusive with contractId.

tools.name: index_blocks
tools.description: List decoded blocks from Index. Keyless on OSS loopback; otherwise needs INSTANCE_TOKEN (OSS) or SECONDLAYER_API_KEY (hosted).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's next_cursor

tools.name: index_transactions
tools.description: List decoded transactions from Index. Filter by type, sender, or contract. Keyless on OSS loopback; otherwise needs INSTANCE_TOKEN (OSS) or SECONDLAYER_API_KEY (hosted).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's next_cursor

tools.name: index_print_schema
tools.description: Empirical per-topic print payload schemas for a contract, inferred from sampled on-chain events: each topic's fields with observed Clarity types, decoded TS types, subgraph column types, and presence rates. Use before writing print_event subgraph handlers to learn what's on e.data. Keyless on OSS loopback; otherwise needs INSTANCE_TOKEN (OSS) or SECONDLAYER_API_KEY (hosted).

contractId.description: Contract id (SP….name) whose print events to profile

tools.name: index_discover
tools.description: Discover the Index vocabulary: every event type and its columns, allowed/equality filters, and required-non-null fields (and which types accept `trait`). Read this before building Index queries instead of guessing filters. Keyless on OSS loopback; otherwise needs INSTANCE_TOKEN (OSS) or SECONDLAYER_API_KEY (hosted).

tools.name: index_runes
tools.description: List the Bitcoin Runes catalog: identity, supply, mints, and mint terms. Keyless on OSS loopback; otherwise needs INSTANCE_TOKEN (OSS) or SECONDLAYER_API_KEY (hosted). Self-host needs the bitcoin compose profile. `notes` says when Runes is not configured.

search.description: Name prefix, spacers and case ignored (dog matches DOG•GO•TO•THE•MOON)

sort.description: number (etch order, default) or mints (busiest first)

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's next_cursor

tools.name: index_rune
tools.description: Get one Bitcoin Rune by id or name. Returns null when not found or Runes is not configured. Keyless on OSS loopback; otherwise needs INSTANCE_TOKEN (OSS) or SECONDLAYER_API_KEY (hosted). Self-host needs the bitcoin compose profile.

rune.description: Rune id (840000:3) or name, any case, with or without spacers

tools.name: index_rune_balances
tools.description: List current Bitcoin Runes balances per unspent output. Pass exactly one of address or outpoint. Keyless on OSS loopback; otherwise needs INSTANCE_TOKEN (OSS) or SECONDLAYER_API_KEY (hosted). Self-host needs the bitcoin compose profile. `notes` says when Runes is not configured.

outpoint.description: Output as txid:vout. Exclusive with address.

rune.description: Narrow to one rune (id or name)

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's next_cursor

tools.name: index_rune_activity
tools.description: List Bitcoin Runes etch, mint, transfer, and burn events. Heights are Bitcoin block heights. Keyless on OSS loopback; otherwise needs INSTANCE_TOKEN (OSS) or SECONDLAYER_API_KEY (hosted). Self-host needs the bitcoin compose profile. `notes` says when Runes is not configured.

address.description: Filter by Bitcoin address (transfers only carry one)

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's next_cursor

tools.name: batch_query
tools.description: Run up to 10 public /v1 reads in one round trip (POST /v1/batch). Each item keeps its own auth/quota/pay-per-call semantics; results return in order with per-item status. Paths must start with /v1/index, /v1/subgraphs, /v1/streams, or /v1/contracts.

tools.name: streams_tip
tools.description: Current canonical chain tip as Streams sees it: block height/hash, burn height, finalized_height, lag_seconds, and the oldest seekable height/cursor for this key's retention window. Call it before a cursor walk to know where the stream ends, and after an ingest to check lag.

tools.name: streams_dumps
tools.description: List the Streams bulk parquet dumps manifest — coverage range, latest_finalized_cursor, and per-file metadata (block range, row count, size, sha256, signed URL). This is the cold backfill path for downloading all raw data; fetch the file URLs directly (e.g. with DuckDB). Requires the dumps base URL to be configured (SL_STREAMS_DUMPS_URL). For live reads use REST GET /v1/streams/events; for tip/lag use streams_tip.

tools.name: contracts_find
tools.description: Discover deployed Stacks contracts conforming to a trait (e.g. "sip-010", "sip-009", "sip-013"). The discovery endpoint for "which contracts implement X". Reads are public.

conformance.description: declared = parsed from source, inferred = ABI shape-match, any = either (default)

include.description: Set to "abi" to include each contract's full ABI

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's next_cursor

tools.name: contracts_get_abi
tools.description: Fetch a single deployed contract's ABI from the registry (prod-safe). Returns the contract's metadata + full ABI (functions, maps, variables, fungible/non-fungible tokens). Returns not_found if the contract isn't in the registry. Use it to inspect a contract before subgraphs_scaffold.

tools.name: account_whoami
tools.description: Show the archive account email at api.secondlayer.tools, not the self-host instance.
